invariants.rationale: The method always creates a new list by collecting from a stream, so result cannot be null.
The stream returns a sorted version of 'records', so the size is preserved.
If input is empty, the return value is also empty; non-empty input yields non-empty output.
The return type is a List as mandated by the method's signature and implementation.
If records are already sorted, result equals records; otherwise, result is the sorted version.
